Hi all,
am Sikandar from Pakistan, According to Pakistan Law we need calculate Tax before discounts and by default behavior Erp Next calculate tax after discount my request add a built in feature to enable or disable tax calculation before discount.

Best Regard’s
Sikandar

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @udunitydistribution

The item line discount and document level discount are available in ERPNext and works dynamically with Pricing Rules for advanced configuration of discounts.

Generally nobody offers discount on tax as seller can only offer discount to what he owns (his products) and sell at any prices with discount and then tax are either applied on item line level incase varies for items within same document otherwise document level discount can serve the purpose.

If you are particularly referring to FMCG Trade Price and MRP pricing setup, tax still remains apart from item pricing.
